name: How long does a full bathroom remodel usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a full bathroom remodel usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a full bathroom remodel varies based on its complexity and the availability of materials. Generally, a typical full remodel can take anywhere from 3 to 6 weeks from demolition to final installation. This timeline accounts for demolition, rough-ins for plumbing and electrical, installation of new fixtures, tiling, painting, and final touches. Factors like custom orders, unforeseen structural issues, or changes during the project can extend this timeframe.
acceptedAnswer.description: A full bathroom remodel typically takes 3 to 6 weeks, depending on complexity and material availability.
